name: Berserk Heroes Online
description:
About This Game

Hear the bugle call above the plains and forests of Laar? It signals the opening of the portal to the world of legendary card battles! Come to Berserk Heroes Online to take part in epic PvP fights, test your tactician's capabilities, and build a unique collection out of 350+ cards. Add the game to your wishlist now.

Card Dueling Classics

Stand in the epicenter of battles between Laar's Heroes' armies. Devise cunning strategies, hire creatures with special abilities, and use both magic and equipment to crush your opponents. Berserk Heroes Online offers six elemental factions. Which one will you choose?

Simple Rules for Dynamic Duels

Never played the card-collecting games before? Don't worry, Berserk Heroes Online is really easy to learn. The game offers a detailed tutorial for your very first battle, the game assistant, and a user-friendly interface. Each duel will take only 10-15 minutes of your time in average, so you won't even have a chance to get bored.

Three Game Modes

The Arena mode is best suited for those who prefer planning their strategy and building decks ahead of time. Maybe you like improvisation and tactical challenges? Try out the Draft mode. And if you feel that even an online card game is more fun with a friend, try the Practice mode.

Collection of Your Dreams

The game offers over 350 cards with unique characters, spells, and equipment, that can be obtained from special boosters. Each new addition to your collection will help you pave your way to victory, and some are sure to become your most treasured possessions. So, are you ready to go hunting for the rarest of cards?

New Look at the Legendary Universe

The history of Laar started in 2003 with a tactical tabletop game Berserk. And now thousands of players all over the world are head over heels with this CCG, always willing to discuss strategy and argue who is stronger: Higart or Cruel Slasher. Berserk Heroes Online expands this universe even more, as it adds new mechanics and cards that even the tabletop game veterans are sure to appreciate.
